using ull = unsigned long long;

const int MAXN = 55, MAXT = 2 * MAXN, MAXP = MAXT * MAXN, MAXE = 5 * MAXT * MAXN * MAXN;
const int INF = 1e9;

inline char gc() {
    static const int BS = 1 << 16;
    static char buf[BS], *p1 = buf, *p2 = buf;
    return p1 == p2 && (p2 = (p1 = buf) + fread(buf, 1, BS, stdin), p1 == p2) ? EOF : *p1++;
}

inline int rd() {
    int x = 0; char c = gc(); bool neg = false;
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { if (c == '-') neg = true; c = gc(); }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = (x << 1) + (x << 3) + (c ^ 48); c = gc(); }
    return neg ? -x : x;
}

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, cost, next;
} edges[MAXE];

int ecnt = 1, head[MAXP];
int N, M, K, C, D, cnt[MAXN];
int node_id[MAXN][MAXT], src = 1, sink = 2, node_count = 2;
bool in_queue[MAXP];
int dist[MAXP];
int total_flow = 0, min_cost = 0;
queue<int> q;

void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    edges[++ecnt] = {v, cap, cost, head[u]};
    head[u] = ecnt;
}

void add_bidirectional(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    add_edge(u, v, cap, cost);
    add_edge(v, u, 0, -cost);
}

bool spfa() {
    fill(dist + 1, dist + node_count + 1, INF);
    fill(in_queue + 1, in_queue + node_count + 1, false);
    dist[src] = 0;
    q.push(src);
    in_queue[src] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        in_queue[u] = false;
        for (int e = head[u]; e; e = edges[e].next) {
            if (edges[e].cap <= 0) continue;
            int v = edges[e].to;
            if (dist[v] > dist[u] + edges[e].cost) {
                dist[v] = dist[u] + edges[e].cost;
                if (!in_queue[v]) {
                    q.push(v);
                    in_queue[v] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[sink] < INF;
}

int dfs(int u, int flow, bool vis[]) {
    if (u == sink) return flow;
    vis[u] = true;
    int pushed = flow;
    for (int e = head[u]; e; e = edges[e].next) {

        int f = dfs(v, min(pushed, edges[e ^ 1].cap), vis);

            edges[e ^ 1].cap += f;
            edges[e].cap -= f;

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, cost, rev;
    Edge(int t, int cap, int cst, int r) : to(t), capacity(cap), cost(cst), rev(r) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
vector<int> dist, prevv, preve;
vector<bool> in_queue;

int N, M, K, C, D;
vector<int> cnt;
vector<vector<int>> node_id;
int src, sink, node_count;

void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    graph[u].emplace_back(v, cap, cost, graph[v].size());
    graph[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, graph[u].size() - 1);
}

bool spfa(int s, int t) {
    fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
    fill(in_queue.begin(), in_queue.end(), false);
    dist[s] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    in_queue[s] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        in_queue[u] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            auto& e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                prevv[e.to] = u;
                preve[e.to] = i;
                if (!in_queue[e.to]) {
                    q.push(e.to);
                    in_queue[e.to] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[t] < INF;
}

int min_cost_flow(int s, int t) {
    int flow = 0, cost = 0;
    while (spfa(s, t)) {
        int f = INF;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
            f = min(f, graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]].capacity);
        }
        flow += f;
        cost += f * dist[t];
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
            auto& e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
            e.capacity -= f;
            graph[v][e.rev].capacity += f;
        }
    }
    return cost;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    cnt.assign(N + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        int x; cin >> x;
        cnt[x]++;
    }

    node_id.assign(N + 1, vector<int>(K + M + 3, 0));
    node_count = 2;
    src = 0; sink = 1;
    graph.resize(2 + N * (K + M + 2));

    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 2; ++j) {

            }
            if (j > 1) {
                add_edge(node_id[i][j - 1], node_id[i][j], INF, 0);
            }
        }
        if (cnt[i]) {
            add_edge(src, node_id[i][1], cnt[i], 0);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < M; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 1; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= 2 * K - 1; k += 2) {
                add_edge(node_id[a][j], node_id[b][j + 1], 1, k * D);
                add_edge(node_id[b][j], node_id[a][j + 1], 1, k * D);
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = min_cost_flow(src, sink);
    assert(flow == K);
    cout << ans << '\n';
